class InterpolationMissingOptionErrorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verify InterpolationMissingOptionError via real ConfigParser.get calls."""

    def _get_basic_missing(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.BasicInterpolation())
        cf.add_section('sec')
        cf.set('sec', 'present', 'value')
        cf.set('sec', 'greeting', 'Hello %(missing)s!')
        try:
            cf.get('sec', 'greeting')
        except configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError as exc:
            return cf, exc
        self.fail('Expected InterpolationMissingOptionError')

    def _get_extended_missing(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cf.add_section('sec')
        cf.set('sec', 'present', 'value')
        cf.set('sec', 'greeting', '${missing}!')
        try:
            cf.get('sec', 'greeting')
        except configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError as exc:
            return cf, exc
        self.fail('Expected InterpolationMissingOptionError')

    def _get_extended_cross_section_missing(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cf.add_section('sec')
        cf.add_section('other')
        cf.set('other', 'name', 'World')
        cf.set('sec', 'greeting', '${other:missing}!')
        try:
            cf.get('sec', 'greeting')
        except configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError as exc:
            return cf, exc
        self.fail('Expected InterpolationMissingOptionError')

    def _assert_exception(self, exc, expected_ref, expected_rawval):
        self.assertIs(type(exc),
                      configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertIsInstance(exc, configparser.InterpolationError)
        self.assertIsInstance(exc, configparser.Error)
        self.assertEqual(exc.option, 'greeting')
        self.assertEqual(exc.section, 'sec')
        self.assertEqual(exc.reference, expected_ref)
        self.assertEqual(exc.args,
                         ('greeting', 'sec', expected_rawval, expected_ref))

    # -- exception class and attributes --

    def test_basic_type_and_attrs(self):
        _, exc = self._get_basic_missing()
        self._assert_exception(exc, 'missing', 'Hello %(missing)s!')

    def test_extended_type_and_attrs(self):
        _, exc = self._get_extended_missing()
        self._assert_exception(exc, 'missing', '${missing}!')

    def test_extended_cross_section_type_and_attrs(self):
        _, exc = self._get_extended_cross_section_missing()
        self._assert_exception(exc, 'other:missing', '${other:missing}!')

    # -- shallow copy --

    def _check_shallow_copy(self, exc):
        sc = copy.copy(exc)
        self.assertIsNot(sc, exc)
        self.assertIs(type(sc),
                      configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(sc.args, exc.args)
        self.assertEqual(sc.option, exc.option)
        self.assertEqual(sc.section, exc.section)
        self.assertEqual(sc.reference, exc.reference)

    def test_basic_shallow_copy(self):
        _, exc = self._get_basic_missing()
        self._check_shallow_copy(exc)

    def test_extended_shallow_copy(self):
        _, exc = self._get_extended_missing()
        self._check_shallow_copy(exc)

    def test_extended_cross_section_shallow_copy(self):
        _, exc = self._get_extended_cross_section_missing()
        self._check_shallow_copy(exc)

    # -- deep copy --

    def _check_deep_copy(self, exc):
        dc = copy.deepcopy(exc)
        self.assertIsNot(dc, exc)
        self.assertIs(type(dc),
                      configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(dc.args, exc.args)
        self.assertEqual(dc.option, exc.option)
        self.assertEqual(dc.section, exc.section)
        self.assertEqual(dc.reference, exc.reference)

    def test_basic_deep_copy(self):
        _, exc = self._get_basic_missing()
        self._check_deep_copy(exc)

    def test_extended_deep_copy(self):
        _, exc = self._get_extended_missing()
        self._check_deep_copy(exc)

    def test_extended_cross_section_deep_copy(self):
        _, exc = self._get_extended_cross_section_missing()
        self._check_deep_copy(exc)

    # -- pickle (all protocols) --

    def _check_pickle_all_protocols(self, exc):
        for proto in range(pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
            buf = pickle.dumps(exc, proto)
            restored = pickle.loads(buf)
            self.assertIs(type(restored),
                          configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
            self.assertEqual(restored.args, exc.args)
            self.assertEqual(restored.option, exc.option)
            self.assertEqual(restored.section, exc.section)
            self.assertEqual(restored.reference, exc.reference)

    def test_basic_pickle_all_protocols(self):
        _, exc = self._get_basic_missing()
        self._check_pickle_all_protocols(exc)

    def test_extended_pickle_all_protocols(self):
        _, exc = self._get_extended_missing()
        self._check_pickle_all_protocols(exc)

    def test_extended_cross_section_pickle_all_protocols(self):
        _, exc = self._get_extended_cross_section_missing()
        self._check_pickle_all_protocols(exc)

    # -- raw=True retrieval --

    def test_basic_raw_true(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.BasicInterpolation())
        cf.add_section('sec')
        cf.set('sec', 'greeting', 'Hello %(missing)s!')
        self.assertEqual(cf.get('sec', 'greeting', raw=True),
                         'Hello %(missing)s!')

    def test_extended_raw_true(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cf.add_section('sec')
        cf.set('sec', 'greeting', '${missing}!')
        self.assertEqual(cf.get('sec', 'greeting', raw=True),
                         '${missing}!')

    def test_extended_cross_section_raw_true(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cf.add_section('sec')
        cf.add_section('other')
        cf.set('sec', 'greeting', '${other:missing}!')
        self.assertEqual(cf.get('sec', 'greeting', raw=True),
                         '${other:missing}!')

    # -- successful lookup after adding the missing reference --

    def test_basic_success_after_adding_ref(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.BasicInterpolation())
        cf.add_section('sec')
        cf.set('sec', 'greeting', 'Hello %(name)s!')
        with self.assertRaises(configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError):
            cf.get('sec', 'greeting')
        cf.set('sec', 'name', 'World')
        self.assertEqual(cf.get('sec', 'greeting'), 'Hello World!')

    def test_extended_success_after_adding_ref(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cf.add_section('sec')
        cf.set('sec', 'greeting', '${name}!')
        with self.assertRaises(configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError):
            cf.get('sec', 'greeting')
        cf.set('sec', 'name', 'World')
        self.assertEqual(cf.get('sec', 'greeting'), 'World!')

    def test_extended_cross_section_success_after_adding_ref(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cf.add_section('sec')
        cf.add_section('other')
        cf.set('sec', 'greeting', '${other:name}!')
        with self.assertRaises(configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError):
            cf.get('sec', 'greeting')
        cf.set('other', 'name', 'World')
        self.assertEqual(cf.get('sec', 'greeting'), 'World!')
